scope: Deeper/broader source and cross-implementation review of SCALE, DICTIONARYVAR, MLINESTYLE, and MLEADERSTYLE adapter retention, raw capture, writer reachability, root graph closure, handle remapping, and version compatibility

method.sourceBranches: LibreCAD/LibreCAD master and LibreDWG/libredwg master are mutable upstream branches; the URLs below identify reviewed files, not immutable source commits
method.principle: Autodesk DXF and ODA DWG references establish format contracts; open-source implementations are cross-checks and integration examples, not semantic qualification of this checkout

localFindings.evidence: Typed DXF parsing/writing exists for flag 70, name 300, paper/drawing units 140/141, and unit-scale bool 290. The DXF parser also produces a raw companion. No dx_iface call site invokes writeScale; dx_iface does not retain this family raw companion. Current source comment labels the ODA section 20.4.93; the ODA PDF search and LibreDWG dwg2.spec identify SCALE as 20.4.92, page 221.

Typed parsing/writing covers schema 280 and value 1 under subclass DictionaryVariables. processDictionaryVar supplies typed and raw callbacks; dx_iface retains only ACAD_PROXY_OBJECT and VISUALSTYLE raw carriers. No dx_iface call site invokes writeDictionaryVar; the root graph cannot index DICTIONARYVAR as a child leaf.

DXF parser ignores code 71 and does not validate complete per-element tuples. The model can hold DWG per-element color24 and R2018+ linetypeHandle, which the DXF writer does not emit. DXF parser supplies a raw companion which the adapter drops. No dx_iface call site invokes writeMLineStyle. The standard DXF representation identifies each linetype by its code-6 name, so DWG linetype handles require unique source-table name resolution rather than direct handle serialization.

Typed writer is limited to AC1021+ but emits 179 and 298 at every admitted version and writes the stored 340-343 references directly, without remapObjectHandle. LibreDWG's DWG spec gates 179 to R2010+ and text_extended 298 to R2013+. The four resource handles denote LTYPE, arrowhead BLOCK, text STYLE, and content BLOCK. processRawCapturedObject publishes a raw companion which dx_iface currently discards. No dx_iface call site invokes writeMLeaderStyle; a typed path also needs MLEADERSTYLE CLASS registration and the correct instance count.

The current bounded traversal target resolver and visited sets cover dictionaries, XRecords and VisualStyles (plus linetypes for specific permitted references). Root-entry admission only recognizes closed dictionaries/XRecords. New leaf dispatch requires unique identity, exact owner and root-entry linkage, handle reservation/remapping, and validation of every admitted non-null reference before publication.

crossImplementationFindings.claim: DICTIONARYVAR has owner dictionary code 330, subclass DictionaryVariables, schema code 280 and value code 1; the reference names ACDBVARIABLEDICTIONARY as owner.
MLINESTYLE uses 2/70/3/62/51/52/71 then repeated 49/62/6 groups; owner is the ACAD_MLINESTYLE NOD dictionary. The MLINE entity's 340 style handle is authoritative over redundant name code 2.
MLEADERSTYLE scalar fields and codes 340-343 are defined as leader-line-type, arrowhead, MText-style and block-content resource IDs. The published table does not enumerate code 179 or 298.
Authoritative DWG byte-layout source. SCALE is listed in section 20.4.92, page 221; MLEADERSTYLE in section 20.4.87.

Open-source DWG schema corroborates SCALE fields and identifies MLEADERSTYLE class-version 179 as R2010+ and text_extended 298 as R2013+. Its master branch is a moving implementation cross-check, not a normative authority.

Current LibreCAD integration emits typed-only DWG-origin records, avoids duplicate raw/typed output by handle for DXF-origin records, registers custom classes, and remaps MLEADERSTYLE line-type/text-style/block references in the DWG output path. Its fallback rehomes unreachable records to the NOD; this plan explicitly rejects that behavior for strict graph-preserving output.

Independent DXF-only implementation describes OBJECTS as an ownership graph with handle-indexed identity, supporting graph-first implementation and testing. This does not qualify libdxfrw output semantics.

DXF persistent inter-object handles distinguish pointer and ownership references; references must remain valid through transformations. The local serializer must map them consistently with newly emitted identities.
